title: Page 8
content_zh:
「但你出现了，短短三个月，让我觉得人生可以被期待。」
「期待什么？」
「快乐——一种我失去很久的东西。」
所以小青鸟做得很好，她真的把快乐带进他的生命里？
她点点头，问：「你怎么知道我在这里？」
「我到处找你，希腊、美国、你的学校……Ross提供我重要线索，于是我回台湾，找到姜医生，弄清楚你的病。接下来，我很感激你打电话给我的答录机，我在里头找到许多蛛丝马迹。
「有一通电话，阿乐不耐烦的催着你说：『再不出门，兴达港的黄昏市场都快关了。』于是我知道你在高雄县：接着我聘征信社寻找你，一个眼睛看不到的漂亮妹妹，是很容易被打听出来的。」
她没有笑。「为什么不直接告诉我，你是阿誉？」
「我有很多疑惑，比如为什么不让我知道你生病，是不是觉得我没办法让你依靠？你为什么躲避医疗，是对姜医生没信心，还是对手术感到恐惧？这些事在我当阿誉的时候你不说，我猜也许换个身份，你会愿意告诉我。」
他拉她坐在自己膝间，圈起她的腰，把她整个人密密包裹。
「你为了这个隐瞒身份？」
「对，这是我的想法，但杜绢有另一套解释。」
她又惊讶的抬头。「杜绢？你们在婚礼之后见过面？」
他满足的摸摸她的脸，然后，很紧很紧的抱住她，像从前一样。「见过，我必须告诉她，我的决定和对她的抱歉。」
「她还好吗？」
「她会很好的，我对她有信心。」杜绢是个坚韧女性。
「一那就好。杜绢怎么说？」
「她说，我在欺骗自己，说我潜意识里想试试，如果你不是晴天的妹妹、我不是阿誉，我们会不会发展出另一种可能性。」再回头思考杜绢的话，他不禁要佩服她的观察力，当时的他，连自己都骗了进去。
「然后？」
她没有对他的欺骗愤愤不平？她是个脾气多么好的女生，爱上这么好「乔」、不懂得利用局势拿乔的女孩子，是他的运气。

「然后我确定，蒋誉爱上跳跳，百分之百、童叟无欺。」
这种情况，她是哭好还是大笑比较合宜？当她快死的时候，老天爷居然送来这份大礼。商天雨的心乱了，乱纷纷的念头在脑袋里面纠缠。
她该高兴的，因为有阿誉，她的生命将会幸福难计，她该开心，因为最爱的阿誉也爱自己，她该得意，因为这个男人，为了不能失去她而逃开一场盛大婚礼……她对他，不再是晴天的妹妹，而是让他人生值得期待的跳跳，他说爱她，说得不容怀疑。
问题是，她怎么能收下他的爱情？几个月的性命经营不出幸福啊！她摇头。「太空船的船票买好了，连出发日期都已经确定，我不能自私自利。」
「丢开无聊的迷信，为我把脑袋里的肿瘤弄掉，好不好？」他紧握她的手。
她说着一说再说的话。「我的运气很差。」
「我的运气很好。」他不介意分享。
「我害怕再次巧合，我不要你或爸爸出事。」
「我们不会有事，我保证。你担心的话，我去请法师来开坛作法，让各路神明保佑我们。」很白痴的说词，但只要她安心，再荒诞的话他都说。
「可是……」
「为了我、为了未来，冒险一次！」他几乎是恳求了。
商天雨不应话。困惑了，她抓不准未来、抓不准明天、抓不准他们之间会往哪个方向进行。
最后，她还是被阿誉的三寸下烂之舌说动。虽然，她仍然迷信，仍然害怕自己缺乏幸运，但为了阿誉和得来不易的爱情，她决定豁出去。
手术定在六天之后：都安排好了，只等她换上病人衣服。
应该回公司主持大局的蒋誉请出老将军坐阵，为了儿子的终生幸福，早已经交出实权的蒋家老爸乖乖回到宝座，认命操劳。
唉，谁说儿孙自有儿孙福，儿孙的幸福还不是要老爸卖命才换得到。
商天雨的东西整理好了，临别辞行，阿桂婶一把眼泪一把鼻涕，阿乐更是满脸臭，一只脚把纱门踢得嘎嘎作响，三不五时就朝蒋誉的方向丢去白眼。
「你要常打电话给我，不可以忘记我会担心。」阿桂婶抓起围裙擦眼泪，胖胖的手指头把眼睛揉得红通通。
「我知道，等眼睛好了，我会回来看你们啊。」说完，商天雨唤阿乐，可他不理人，她连声喊，「阿乐、阿乐，你在哪里？」
被叫急了，他不甘愿的回答，「厚，干么啦，林北很忙。」

「我想抱你。」她伸出两只手对着空气，脸上尽是撒娇。
哇靠，抱什么抱啦！会给人家误会，也不动动大脑，她最爱的那个死阿誉就站在旁边，不怕转过头就给她算帐哦！
「给我抱一下嘛～」
见她的手在空中挥半天，他才别别扭扭的走到她身边。
第13章(2)
商天雨抱住青少年，头靠在他胸口，柔声对他说：「阿乐的胸膛很舒服呢，以后一定会有个很善良、很爱阿乐的女生靠在这边，阿乐要对人家好一点哦。」
北七哦，舒服就多靠一下，干么七早八早就离开，他又没给她收费。
「等我动完手术，阿乐一定要到台北看我。」
他不想说话，只想「蒜晓」，把那个阿誉的祖宗八代全抓出来问候一通。看不见就看不见嘛，干么非叫跳跳去开刀？开刀很危险，他是不知道有那种会把剪刀丢在病人脑袋里的北七医生哦！
「我放假就去。」他别扭说。
「台北的女生很漂亮，说不定有可爱的小护士会喜欢我们家阿乐。」
又要北七，他只喜欢跳跳，其他的女人都不要啦。
「阿乐在生气吗？」她把头靠在他肩上，有点委屈。
他酷酷地丢下字。「没。」
「阿乐不要气我，你是跳跳最好的朋友。」
最好的朋友？她取悦他了，丑丑的酷脸拉出微笑，虽然她说的不是「最好的男朋友」，不过没关系，阿誉会老、他会长大，总有一天，他的条件会比阿誉好，到时如果跳跳反悔，男朋友想换人，他一定马上举双手报到。
「我给你的符水，要记得拿去泡澡。」师父是说要洒在身上啦，不过他觉得泡澡大概效果会更好。
「知道。」
「进开刀房前要念十句南无大慈大悲救苦救难观世音菩萨。」他很像坐在庙口前的老阿嬷。
「知道。」

「开车小心一点。」他打死不说再见。
「知道。」跳跳话应完，才发觉不对，又不是她开的车，干么叫她小心一点？直到阿誉出声，她才晓得阿乐在对阿誉说话。
「谢谢你的关心。」蒋誉回答。
这算不算融冰啊，阿乐居然跟阿誉说话耶？商天雨笑眯眼，甜甜的笑脸让阿乐看呆了。
道过再见，商天雨和蒋誉上了车，阿乐追在车后送了好一段路，才放下高挥的右手，在心底，悄悄对跳跳说了再见。
白色的病床、白色的墙、白色的跳跳、白色的哀伤。
她把病情拖坏了，检查出来的报告很伤脑筋，蒋誉沉痛，却主张隐瞒病人，但姜医生认为她有权利知道病情。
他说：「商天雨越能勇敢面对，手术成功率越高。」
这个主张让商天雨知道自己的状况，不乐观，但她不得不闯闯看。
这几天，她有阿誉陪在身边，片刻不离，为她说笑话，他们东扯西聊，说过去、论未来，还说等她病情好，要找时间去看看妈妈和晴天，也许把妈妈的骨灰带来和晴天一起安葬。
content_en:
"But you showed up. In just three months, you made me feel that life can be expected."
"What to expect?"
"Happiness - something I have lost for a long time."
So the little bluebird did a great job, did she really bring happiness into his life?
She nodded and asked, "How did you know I was here?"
"I looked for you everywhere, in Greece, the United States, your school... Ross provided me with important clues, so I returned to Taiwan and found Dr. Jiang to figure out your illness. Next, I am very grateful to the answering machine you called me. I found many clues in it.
"There was a phone call. Ah Le urged you impatiently and said, 'If you don't go out, the dusk market in Xingda Port will be closed soon.' So I knew you were in Kaohsiung County: Then I hired a credit agency to find you. A beautiful girl who is invisible can be easily found out."
She didn't smile. "Why don't you tell me directly that you are Ayu?"
"I have a lot of doubts. For example, why didn't you let me know that you were sick? Do you think I can't rely on you? Why are you avoiding medical treatment? Is it because you have no confidence in Dr. Jiang or are you afraid of surgery? You didn't tell me these things when I was Ayu. I guess maybe you would be willing to tell me if you changed your identity."
He pulled her to sit between his knees, wrapped his arms around her waist, and wrapped her whole body tightly.
"You're hiding your identity for this?"
"Yes, this is my idea, but Du Juan has another explanation."
She looked up in surprise again. "Du Juan? Did you meet after the wedding?"
He touched her face with satisfaction, and then hugged her very tightly, just like before. "I've seen her. I have to tell her my decision and how sorry I am to her."
"Is she okay?"
"She will be fine, I have confidence in her." Du Juan is a tough woman.
"That's good. What did Du Juan say?"
"She said that I was deceiving myself, saying that I subconsciously wanted to try, if you were not Qingtian's sister and I was not Ayu, would we have developed another possibility." Thinking back to Du Juan's words, he couldn't help but admire her observation skills. At that time, he even deceived himself.
"Then?"
She wasn't aggrieved by his deception? She is a girl with such a good temper. It is his luck to fall in love with such a good "Qiao" girl who does not know how to take advantage of the situation to take advantage of Qiao.
"Then I am sure that Jiang Yu fell in love with Tiao Tiao, 100%, pure and innocent."
In this situation, would it be more appropriate for her to cry or laugh? When she was about to die, God actually sent this gift. Shang Tianyu's heart was confused, and chaotic thoughts were tangled in his head.
She should be happy, because with Ayu, her life will be filled with endless happiness. She should be happy, because her beloved Ayu also loves her. She should be proud, because this man ran away from a grand wedding in order not to lose her... To him, she was no longer Qingtian's sister, but the one who made his life worth looking forward to. He said he loved her, and there was no doubt about it.
The question is, how can she accept his love? A few months of life cannot produce happiness! She shook her head. "The tickets for the spaceship have been purchased and the departure date has been determined. I can't be selfish."
"Put aside the boring superstition and get rid of the tumor in my head, okay?" He held her hand tightly.
She said the same thing again and again. "I have bad luck."
"I've had good luck." He doesn't mind sharing.
"I'm afraid of another coincidence. I don't want anything to happen to you or Dad."
"We will be fine, I promise. If you are worried, I will ask a mage to open an altar and let the gods bless us." It was a very idiotic thing to say, but as long as she felt at ease, he would say no matter how absurd it was.
"But..."
"For me, for the future, take a risk!" he almost begged.
Shang Tianyu didn't answer. Confused, she can't grasp the future or tomorrow, not sure which direction they will go.
In the end, she was persuaded by Ayu's three-inch tongue. Although she was still superstitious and still afraid of her lack of luck, she decided to go all out for Ayu and her hard-won love.
The operation was scheduled for six days: everything was arranged, just waiting for her to change into patient clothes.
Jiang Yu, who should return to the company to take charge of the overall situation, invited the old general to take charge. For the sake of his son's lifelong happiness, the Jiang family's father, who had already surrendered his real power, returned to the throne obediently and accepted his fate and worked hard.
Alas, who said that children and grandchildren have their own blessings? The happiness of children and grandchildren does not require dad to work hard to obtain it.
After Shang Tianyu packed up his things and said goodbye, Aunt Agui burst into tears and runny nose, and Ale's face was full of stench. He kicked the screen door with one foot and rattled it, and rolled his eyes in Jiang Yu's direction from time to time.
"You have to call me often and don't forget that I will worry." Aunt Agui grabbed her apron to wipe her tears, rubbing her eyes until they were red with her fat fingers.
"I know. When my eyes are healed, I will come back to see you." After saying that, Shang Tianyu called Ale, but he ignored him. She kept shouting, "Ale, Ale, where are you?"
Being called anxious, he reluctantly replied, "Hou, what are you doing? Lin Bei is very busy."
"I want to hug you." She stretched out her hands to face the air, her face full of coquettishness.
Wow, what are you hugging? It will give others misunderstandings, and she won't use her brain. The dead Ayu she loves is standing next to her, and he is not afraid to turn his head and settle the accounts for her!
"Give me a hug~"
Seeing her hand waving in the air for a long time, he awkwardly walked to her side.
Chapter 13(2)
Shang Tianyu hugged the young man, rested his head on his chest, and said to him softly: "A Le's chest is very comfortable. There will definitely be a kind-hearted girl who loves A Le very much in the future. A Le should be nice to others."
Beiqi, just lean on her if you feel comfortable. Why did you leave so early in the morning? He didn't charge her.
"After I finish the operation, Ah Le must come to Taipei to see me."
He didn't want to talk, he just wanted to say "Garlic Dawn" and capture all the eight generations of Ayu's ancestors to greet them. If you can't see it, you can't see it. Why do you have to ask Tiaotiao to do the surgery? Surgery is very dangerous. He didn't know that there was a doctor Beiqi who would throw the scissors into the patient's head!
"I'll go on vacation." He said awkwardly.
"The girls in Taipei are very beautiful. Maybe there is a cute little nurse who will like our Ale."
He wants Beiqi again. He only likes Tiaotiao and doesn’t want other women.
"Are you angry?" She rested her head on his shoulder, a little aggrieved.
He dropped the words coolly. "No."
"Ale, don't be angry with me, you are Tiaotiao's best friend."
Best friend? She had pleased him, and a smile appeared on her ugly face. Although she was not talking about "the best boyfriend", it didn't matter. Ayu would grow old and grow up. One day, his conditions would be better than Ayu's. If Tiaotiao regrets and his boyfriend wants to change, he will immediately raise his hands to report.
"Remember to take the talisman water I gave you to take a bath." The master meant to sprinkle it on your body, but he thought that taking a bath would be more effective.
"I know."
"Before entering the surgery room, you should recite ten lines of Namo's Great Merciful and Great Compassion to save the suffering and save the suffering Guanyin Bodhisattva." He looked like the old grandma sitting in front of the temple.
"I know."
"Drive carefully." He refused to say goodbye.
"I know." After Tiaotiao responded, she realized something was wrong. She wasn't driving the car, so why should she be careful? She didn't know that A Le was talking to A Yu until A Yu spoke up.
"Thank you for your concern." Jiang Yu replied.
Is this considered melting the ice? Ah Le actually talked to A Yu? Shang Tianyu smiled and narrowed his eyes, and A Le was stunned by his sweet smile.
After saying goodbye, Shang Tianyu and Jiang Yu got into the car. A Le chased behind the car for a long time before he put down his waving right hand and said in his heart,Quietly said goodbye to Tiao Tiao.
White hospital bed, white wall, white jumping, white sadness.
She delayed the condition, and the test report was very troublesome. Jiang Yu was deeply saddened, but advocated hiding the patient, but Dr. Jiang believed that she had the right to know the condition.
He said: "The more Shang Tianyu can face it bravely, the higher the success rate of the operation."
This suggestion made Shang Tianyu know that her situation was not optimistic, but she had to take a look.
In the past few days, she had Ayu by her side, who stayed with her and told her jokes. They chatted about the past and the future. They also said that when she recovered, they would find time to visit her mother and Qingtian, and maybe bring her mother's ashes to be buried with Qingtian.
